cases.covers: Hand-written from CP-1A.md lines 99-110 of the C2 run: ABL 42 documented funded, 125 as a Memo commitment, Total sources 821 as printed against components 820; the 1 difference is logged in prose and not plugged.
cases.findings:
### Sources and uses

| Side | Item | Amount | Currency | Basis | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Source | ABL facility drawing at closing | 42 | USD | documented | LP page:5, proposed sources; USD millions |
| Source | Term loan B | 720 | USD | documented | LP page:5; USD millions |
| Source | Cash from balance sheet | 18 | USD | documented | LP page:5; USD millions |
| Source | Mattress Firm equity issued to seller — noncash | 40 | USD | documented | LP pages 4–5; USD millions |
| Source | Total sources | 821 | USD | documented | LP page:5, printed total; the rows above sum to 820; USD millions |
| Memo | ABL facility size (commitment) | 125 | USD | user-entered | Context page:1, abl-revolver size_m; USD millions |
| Use | Purchase of Sleep Train | 440 | USD | documented | LP page:5, proposed total consideration; USD millions |
| Use | Purchase of bolt-ons | 66 | USD | documented | LP page:5; USD millions |
| Use | Mattress Firm existing debt | 297 | USD | documented | LP page:5; USD millions |
| Use | Illustrative fees and expenses | 18 | USD | documented | LP page:5; USD millions |
| Use | Total uses | 821 | USD | documented | calculate: 440 + 66 + 297 + 18; USD millions |

**Analyst Interpretation — difference logged, not resolved.** LP prints total sources of USD 821 million and its source rows sum to USD 820 million. That USD 1 million difference is unresolved and is not offset by a balancing row. The ABL commitment of USD 125 million is a Memo row and is in no total.
cases.basis: Rulings R-C2-1 and the C2 run's own numbers: CP-1A.md lines 99-110, Total uses 821 equals the sum 440 + 66 + 297 + 18; printed Total sources 821 against 820 summed (c2-assessment.md section 1a). Checker is structure-only, so the 1 difference is a prose duty of the instruction, not a checker result.
